title: Coffee-Rubbed Barbecue Pulled Pork
ingredients: SPICE MIX: 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp fine-ground espresso coffee, 1 tsp garlic granules, 1 tsp coarse sea salt, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
SAUCE: 150ml (1/4 pint) chicken stock, 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 2 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
method: Make up the spice rub by mixing everything in a bowl.
Place the pork tenderloins into the slow-cooker pot and rub them all over with the spice mix.

Make up the sauce by mixing all the ingredients together in a small bowl. Pour this around the pork, then place the lid on the slow-cooker. Cook on low for 6-8 hours (best results), or on high for 4-6 hours.
Use 2 forks to shred the tender pork and mix it into the juices to absorb the flavours.
notes: Serve in lightly toasted wholemeal baps with Super Slaw and Quick Purple Pickle (p.183 & p.210). Oven method: 180°C/160°C fan, Gas Mark 4, casserole with lid, 2 hours.
